published_ontology_contract_baseline: v1.0.0 historical; 2.0.0-alpha.1 research contract, not invented stable 2.0.0

adopted_operating_direction.owner: Assistant prepares, researches, implements and verifies; Araz decides actual scientific commitments and release-scope/rights choices

proposed_21_contract.basis: Frozen W5/W6 research contract plus bounded M1 provenance addition, subject to exact dependency and compatibility audit
stable_api: Exact selected concept/relation IRIs and definitions
Selected logical axioms and selected SHACL profile behavior
Selected RDB mapping outputs and normalized SQL/SPARQL contracts
Versioned supported artifact/import list and migration/deprecation rules
exclusions: No automatic promotion of the whole modern 536-element native candidate
No claim of full 20-family candidate validation
No automatic acceptance of RM/PV/BA/DS experimental packages
No completed expert/user study or product-readiness claim
nondeferrable: No unresolved critical defect inside the retained support/dependency closure
Actual author acceptance for retained semantic decisions
Exact tested current contract and affected regressions
Clear source/third-party rights and notices for distributed assets
Versioned limitations, minimum usage/reproduction path and reviewed immutable release

releases.goal: Usable stable core with a small supported provenance/mapping path
releases.scope: Exact reviewed subset only; frozen compatibility contract retained; rest separately experimental
releases.exit: D-01 approved; exact dependency/critical-defect and selected requirement/quality review passed; new assembly/replay and release review

releases.goal: Compatible corrections and small maintenance deliveries
releases.scope: Actual backward-compatible fixes; no new mandatory meaning or arbitrary version bumps
releases.exit: Affected regression and immutable next patch release

releases.goal: Incrementally mature opt-in native/domain and source/mapping extensions
releases.scope: Prioritize one completed feature/module at a time; broader #310/#315/#311–314 and deferred ORSD work remain tracked
releases.exit: A selected new backward-compatible capability and its actual tests/review; split further increments as 2.2.x or 2.3+ as appropriate

releases.goal: Cross-context data/application capability and stronger evaluation
releases.scope: Selected Observatory tasks/mappings, target-aligned human/expert evidence and research/docs in separate lanes
releases.exit: Actual new compatible functionality; studies/doc-only results follow their own artifact version or patch instead of forcing a minor bump

releases.goal: Reviewed integrated generation with explicit migrations where needed
releases.scope: Intentional incompatible semantic/schema restructuring only when justified; integrate mature modules and evidence
releases.exit: Breaking-change inventory, migration contract, review and tested claims; maturity alone does not require a major bump

releases.scope: Reserve for a future demonstrated incompatible evolution; no committed feature backlog or GA prerequisite today
releases.exit: Future evidence-based scope and migration decision

cadence.rule: After 2–4 accepted packets, check for the smallest eligible release; publish only meaningful changes with passing scoped gates
cadence.hold_rule: If a packet is blocked by a decision/evidence, checkpoint it and select a ready independent audit without inferring approval
process_artifacts: Immutable new release plus downloaded-byte receipt
